name_reason: Conforms to fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Descriptor accurately reflects the body: a per-character predicate returning immune/not-immune. No Ghidra address residue. Although the result also gates terrain AP/DP bonuses at call sites, 'status_immunity' is the documented primary semantic and the name is not misleading.
purpose: Predicate: is the given battle character immune to status effects (and, at call sites, to terrain AP/DP modifiers)?
logic_summary: rc = data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[char_idx]. Returns 1 (immune) iff rc->portrait_id != 0x1C AND (rc->job_id == 0x13 OR rc->archetype_flag == 4 OR rc->archetype_flag == 5); otherwise returns 0. Portrait 0x1C is an explicit override that forces not-immune even when the job/archetype condition would otherwise qualify. Leading __CHK(4,...) is the Watcom stack-probe/bounds check, not game logic.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[] selecting the runtime character to test. Callers pass attacker_idx / defender_idx / target_idx slot indices.
params.reason: src/ already declares the good name char_idx, but the live Ghidra parameter is the generic placeholder param_1. Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra parameter param_1 -> char_idx to match src; src declaration already correct and is left untouched this stage.

returns.semantics: 1 = immune (status effects and terrain modifiers skipped), 0 = not immune.

notes: src comment block (battle.c lines 237-242) is accurate, concise and ASCII; kept as-is. Ghidra plate is richer (caller breakdown + semantics of 'immune') and consistent with refined understanding; not modified. Verified field offsets via types.h: portrait_id +0x07, archetype_flag +0x1F, job_id +0x20, matching the plate's bPortrait_id/bArchetype_flag/bJob_id. Caller fd2_execute_attack_damage_calculation confirms the return value gates the terrain AP/DP bonus (immune -> skip). 13 distinct callers / 17 call sites. battle.c not modified, so staged scope is only the shard JSON.
